application_credentials.description: Follow the [Google Photos Picker setup instructions]({more_info_url}) to create an OAuth client ID. Use redirect URI: `{redirect_url}`. After creating credentials at {oauth_creds_url}, enter the Client ID and Client Secret below.

pick_media.title: Pick photos
pick_media.description:
1. Open the [Google Photos Picker]({picker_uri}) in your browser **while signed in to the same Google account**.
2. Select the photos or album you want to rotate.
3. Confirm your selection in Google Photos.
4. Come back here and press **Submit**.

If you press Submit before confirming in Google Photos, you'll be asked to try again.

error.picker_not_ready: Selection not detected yet. Confirm your photo selection in Google Photos, then press Submit again.
error.picker_session_failed: Could not communicate with Google Photos Picker. Check your network and try again.

abort.oauth_unauthorized: OAuth authorization error while obtaining access token.
abort.missing_configuration: The component is not configured. Please follow the documentation.
abort.no_url_available: No URL available. For information about this error, [check the help section]({docs_url}).
abort.picker_session_failed: Failed to create a Google Photos Picker session.
abort.list_items_failed: Failed to list picked media items.
abort.no_items_picked: No items were picked in the Google Photos Picker.
